features.title: **Full-stack** product development
features.text: Web, mobile, backend, infrastructure. Kami ang may-ari ng buong pipeline para mas mabilis kang mag-ship at makatulog nang payapa — malinis na architecture, automated tests, at observability mula day one.

features.title: **Mobile apps** na karapat-dapat sa home screen
features.text: Native iOS, native Android, at React Native — piliin ang tamang tool, i-ship sa parehong stores, at panatilihin ang release train gamit ang CI/CD at crash monitoring.

features.title: **Product strategy** at ongoing partnership
features.text: Roadmaps, user research, pricing experiments, analytics setup. Hindi kami bumubuo at umaalis — tinutulungan ka naming sukatin ang mahalaga at mag-iterate.

features.title: **UI/UX** Design
features.text: Gumagawa kami ng magaganda at intuitive na interface na gustong-gusto ng users. Mula wireframes hanggang pixel-perfect visual design, natural at kasiya-siya ang bawat interaction sa lahat ng device.
